items.quote: the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me
items.claim: God of Abraham and Isaac was with Jacob

items.quote: surely thou hadst sent me away now empty
items.claim: Without divine protection, Laban would have sent Jacob away empty

items.quote: God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands
items.claim: God observed Jacob's affliction and labor
items.object: mine affliction and the labour of my hands

items.quote: God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight
